To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Agricultural Cooperatives should use their brands to promote their products and to enhance their value added in the market, while they can also use quality schemes to improve their products.Originality/value – The value of this paper lies in the fact that it is the first attempt to address this issue in the Greek context, where Agricultural Cooperatives have not been able to develop a brand for their products.
Agricultural Cooperatives should develop their own brands for their products.

(a) the development of brands for agricultural products by agricultural cooperatives is a difficult and complex process, (b) the use of quality schemes and quality systems by agricultural cooperatives could be a solution to overcome these difficulties, and (c) the development of a brand by a cooperative should be based on the use of quality systems, and (d) the development of quality systems by agricultural cooperative should be based in a quality scheme.

the question of how Agricultural Cooperatives can develop their products into brands.
the development of a strategy to combine quality systems and brands for agricultural cooperatives' products.

the development of a brand for the Agricultural Cooperatives and the way it could be used in order to enhance their products.Originality/value – The original contribution of this paper is the examination of how Agricultural Cooperatives can combine quality systems and branding to enhance their products and to differentiate them in the competitive market of food products.
